headline: Volume up, value down: $9k more spend bought the same revenue as last Tuesday
commentary:
### The day
- **$3,179 NP at 7.5% margin**, and the gap to last Tuesday is all cost.
  - NP: $3,179 v $11,912 last Tue
  - Cost: $39,232 v $30,081
  - True commission: $42,411 v $41,993
- Cost sat on the eight-Tuesday average; last week's $30k day was the cheap outlier.
  - Eight-Tuesday mean cost: $39,457
  - Eight-Tuesday mean NP: $5,503
  - Blended EPL: $14.00 v $15.19 eight-week low
- November is still ahead of October at the same point.
  - MTD NP: $68,013 v $58,892
  - MTD NM: 16.2% v 15.2%

### What drove it
- Search paid 20% more for clicks and got the same commission back.
  - Clicks: 2,769 v 2,296
  - Search CPC: $11.45 v $10.43
  - Search commission: $30,042 v $29,541
- Search lead value landed on the month's run rate; last Tuesday was the high one.
  - Search EPL: $25.44 v $25.88 MTD
  - Last Tue: $31.23
- **CPC inflation in the pricey campaigns**, and competitor spend tripled off a small base.
  - payday_alternative CPC: $16.03 v $13.95
  - cash_advance CPC: $15.65 v $12.47
  - competitor cost: $2,341 v $703
- Every tree came in softer, so it isn't one buyer pulling back.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $18.40 v $20.23 last7
  - Test tree EPL: $14.78 v $18.71

### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 10/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| None logged | — | — | — | — |
- Nothing in the notes this cycle, so no test reads today.
- No logged change behind speed's jump in spend; the scavengers were flat.
  - speed cost: $1,924 v $810
  - amount_scavenger cost: $482 v $491
watch: Search CPC at $11.45 against the $10.91 month average, and whether it settles back.
Competitor and speed at their new spend levels, and whether the extra clicks earn out.
Bing, which came in at minus $43 NP on an EPL of $11.52 against $12.80 MTD.
